policy.source_preference: reuse mature free/open-source GitHub projects before writing local replacements
policy.action_pin_policy: pin GitHub Actions to immutable full commit SHA
policy.binary_pin_policy: pin releases/commits and record integrity material before operational use
policy.scope_rule: security-testing tools may only be used when the repository authority state permits the relevant activity

components.purpose: repository security posture and supply-chain practice assessment
GitHub Actions workflow syntax and semantic linting
secret detection in repository content and history
vulnerability, misconfiguration, secret and software inventory scanning
known-vulnerability scanning from files, images or SBOMs
Python static security analysis of trusted control scripts
GitHub Actions dependency update automation; executed by GitHub's hosted Dependabot service using the open-source core logic
dependency vulnerability and lockfile/SBOM analysis against OSV data
web application security testing and automation against explicitly authorized targets
